# Lab 26.3: Third-Party Ingestion

## What We Are Going to Do
See how a partner ELT tool (for example Fivetran) loads a SaaS source into BigQuery with managed connectors. This is a demo with a free trial account.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Prepare a destination for the tool.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq --location=US mk --dataset $PROJECT_ID:lab26_elt
gcloud iam service-accounts create elt-tool --display-name="ELT tool"
ELT_SA=elt-tool@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID --member=serviceAccount:$ELT_SA --role=roles/bigquery.jobUser --quiet
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false "GRANT \`roles/bigquery.dataEditor\` ON SCHEMA lab26_elt TO 'serviceAccount:$ELT_SA'"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Most tools also offer their own service account; then grant the roles to that instead.

2. **Connect in the tool.** In the ELT tool, add **BigQuery** as the destination (project, dataset `lab26_elt`, location US). Add a source such as Google Sheets, HubSpot or a sample database.

3. **Run a sync.** The tool creates tables in `lab26_elt` and keeps them updated on a schedule, including schema changes.

4. **[SQL] Inspect the synced tables.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT table_name, row_count, TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(last_modified_time) AS last_modified
FROM lab26_elt.__TABLES__;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Discuss build vs buy.** Use the Data Transfer Service when a Google connector exists; use a partner tool for hundreds of other SaaS sources; build your own only when nothing fits.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Destination | Dedicated dataset and identity |
| Sync | Managed, scheduled, schema-aware |
| Choice | DTS vs partner vs custom |
| Lab type | Demo |
